bio: A modern and dynamic establishment, divided between a cocktail bar area and a bistrot with contemporary, welcoming furnishings. The generous outdoor terrace is ideal for enjoying a pleasantly relaxed atmosphere. The kitchen offers dishes from Croatian and Mediterranean tradition, revisited with a creative and contemporary touch. Not to be missed are the “Štrukli vol. 2”, an original interpretation of a classic local speciality, as well as an inviting selection of desserts for the sweet-toothed.
